text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—An early holiday afternoon. At a café on 
the way back from shopping, engrossed in 
the newly bought Monthly Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was an article about "DREAMS" 
featuring a photo of <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi's passionately written 
article. The headline that especially 
caught your eye was—
choice_data_list:
"The day will come when I stand at the top 
of the world."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi's Article
text_block_list.text:
"Winning in front of race fans all across 
the world and bathing in their cheers—<chrname>."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi's Article
text_block_list.text:
“Right now, it's nothing more than a 
wishful desire. Even so, she definitely 
has the power to make it happen.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi's Article
text_block_list.text:
"This reporter cannot help but pray that 
her path forward will ultimately bear 
fruit at the Breeders' Cup."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The article concluded with those words. It 
felt as though I had received deeply 
encouraging support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. For the sake of a shining 
future, there is so much I need to do 
right now.
